evaluation_criteria.details: Top-to-bottom, left-to-right hierarchy; semantic heading order (Title -> Subtitle -> Content -> Actions)
Light canvas (#F5F2EB) vs Text Primary (#1A1612) ratio 14.8:1; Dark basalt (#12100E) vs Text Primary (#FAF8F5) ratio 16.2:1 (exceeds WCAG AAA 7:1)
All status and truth badges combine distinct iconography with explicit text labels (e.g., Checkmark + Verified, Schedule Clock + Scheduled, Alert Triangle + Candidate)
Containers employ vertical reflow and flexible auto-layout; no fixed line-box constraints; chips wrap to multi-line at 200% scaling
Android components enforce 48dp minimum target bounds; iOS components enforce 44pt minimum target bounds
Full accessibility toggle from spatial map view to structured accessible list sheet with identical filtering and sorting
Initial accessibility focus shifts to sheet header; dismissal action clearly labeled; background surfaces marked inaccessible while modal
All navigation, search, and truth actions possess semantic text or explicit contentDescription / accessibilityLabel
Type scales incorporate 1.35x line leading minimum to prevent clipping of vowel matras and conjunct glyphs
All spring animations and container transforms degrade gracefully to instant cut or subtle cross-dissolve (150ms)
Error surfaces provide unambiguous recovery buttons (e.g., Retry Search, View Cached Destinations)
